how: statements the seat itself withdrew or corrected in the two dated notes at the head of the file (2026-10-15): 'at c = 6 it selects nothing' is wrong as worded (the root is the action's most probable thread at every c: 27, 50 or 66 per cent at c = 6); 'the thread is the whole question for the hierarchy' is wrong (the cell matters as much); 'the weave cannot choose a sign of CP' is withdrawn as a failure (between CP-conjugate vacua the sign is a convention); 'the 2-3 hierarchy is carried by K, not by Y' is not supported (the SM seat's W86: K carries most of the trend and Y's shape sets the level). The lines below the head that still carry the old wording are superseded by those notes
note: The seat left the body as written and put the corrections at the head; main's B1652 took the corrected forms.
